starting-off-without-the-requirements.speaker: Thormac
starting-off-without-the-requirements.text: Hello I am Thormac the sorcerer.

starting-off-without-the-requirements.speaker: Thormac
starting-off-without-the-requirements.text: Not right now, but thank you for offering.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Scorpion Catcher quest.

starting-off-with-the-requirements.speaker: Thormac
starting-off-with-the-requirements.text: Hello I am Thormac the sorcerer. I don't suppose you could be of assistance to me?

options.text: What do you need assistance with?

steps.player: What do you need assistance with?

steps.speaker: Thormac
steps.text: I've lost my pet scorpions. They're lesser Kharid scorpions, a very rare breed.

steps.speaker: Thormac
steps.text: I left their cage door open, now I don't know where they've gone.

steps.speaker: Thormac
steps.text: There's three of them, and they're quick little beasties. They're all over Gielinor.

steps.player: How would I go about catching them?

steps.speaker: Thormac
steps.text: Well I have a scorpion cage here which you can use to catch them in.

steps.speaker: Thormac
steps.text: If you go up to the village of Seers, to the North of here, one of them will be able to tell you where the scorpions are now.

steps.player: Okay, I will do it then.

steps.speaker: Thormac
steps.text: Blast! I suppose I'll have to find someone else then.

steps.speaker: Thormac
steps.text: Fair enough.

starting-off-subsequent-dialogue.player: I've not caught all the scorpions yet.

starting-off-subsequent-dialogue.speaker: Thormac
starting-off-subsequent-dialogue.text: Well remember to go speak to the Seers, North of here, if you need any help.

options.text: I need to locate some scorpions.

steps.player: I need to locate some scorpions.

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: Well you have come to the right place. I am a master of animal detection.

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: Do you need to locate any particular scorpion? Scorpions are a creature somewhat in abundance.

steps.player: I'm looking for some lesser Kharid scorpions. They belong to Thormac the Sorcerer.

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: Let me look into my looking glass.
The seer produces a small mirror
The seer gazes into the mirror
The seer smoothes his hair with hand

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: I can see a scorpion that you seek. It would appear to be near some nasty spiders. I can see two coffins there as well.

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: The scorpion seems to be going through some crack in the wall. It's gone into some sort of secret room.

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: Well see if you can find that scorpion then, and I'll try and get you some information on the others.

options.text: Where did you say that scorpion was again?

steps.player: Where did you say that scorpion was again?

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: Let me look into my looking glass.

options.text: I've retrieved the scorpion from near the spiders.

steps.player: I've retrieved the scorpion from near the spiders.

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: Well, I've checked my looking glass. There seems to be a kharid scorpion in a little village in the east, surrounded by lots of uncivilised-looking warriors. Some kind of merchant there seems to have picked it up.

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: That's all I can tell you about that scorpion.

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: It's good that you should ask. I have information on the last scorpion for you.

steps.speaker: Seer
steps.text: It seems to be in some sort of upstairs room. There seems to be some sort of brown clothing lying on a table.

second-and-third-scorpions-brotherly-lov.speaker: Peksa
second-and-third-scorpions-brotherly-lov.text: Are you interested in buying or selling a helmet?

options.text: I've heard you have a small scorpion in your possession.

steps.player: I've heard you have a small scorpion in your possession.

steps.speaker: Peksa
steps.text: Now how could you know about that, I wonder? Mind you, I don't have it anymore.

steps.speaker: Peksa
steps.text: I gave it as a present to my brother Ivor when I visited our outpost northwest of Camelot.

steps.speaker: Peksa
steps.text: Well, actually I hid it in his bed so it would nip him. It was a bit of a surprise gift.

finishing-up.player: I have retrieved all your scorpions.

finishing-up.speaker: Thormac
finishing-up.text: Aha, my little scorpions home at last!
